answer: A gale of fake identities hits the network every epoch. Each agent docks at a wharf of proof: a 50-unit bond and a beacon-puzzle heartbeat per epoch. The beacon audits 10% per epoch; a missed heartbeat slashes the bond and deletes it. Forging 100 fakes locks 5,000 units plus 200 compute per epoch against 200 in rewards, so fakes lose money. Honest agents pay 50 once and earn steadily. Without bond and heartbeat, a fake cannot wander the network.
